title: ECAD package mechanical dimensions (IPC-7351B land-pattern input)
description: Contract an LLM fills from a datasheet mechanical drawing. All lengths in millimetres. Give each dimension as min/max where the drawing shows a range (preferred), or nom (+ optional tol = symmetric +/-). Never guess: if a value is not on the drawing, omit it and list it in 'unresolved'. Orientation: pin 1 top-left; X axis = across the pad rows (lead span), Y axis = along a pin row. Ball grids (bga), pin headers, connectors and odd shapes (custom) use the fields marked for them; connector and custom parts are given as a pad_table copied from the datasheet's recommended land pattern / PCB layout drawing.

dim.description: A toleranced dimension in mm. Either {min,max} (optionally nom) or {nom, tol}.

name.description: Footprint name, KiCad style, e.g. SOIC-8_3.9x4.9mm_P1.27mm

package_type.description: chip = 2-terminal rectangular end-cap (R/C/L/LED 0201..2512); molded = 2-terminal molded body with terminals bent under it (tantalum caps, SMA/SMB/SMC diodes, power inductors); gullwing = leads out of the body sides (SOIC/SOP/TSSOP/MSOP/SOT-23/SOT-223/SOD-123, use pin_positions for uneven layouts); qfp = gull-wing leads on four sides (QFP/LQFP/TQFP), lead_span is the tip-to-tip span; qfn = quad/dual flat no-lead (QFN/DFN/SON) with optional exposed pad; bga = BGA/LGA/CSP/WLCSP ball or land grid (rows x cols, pitch, ball_diameter, depopulated balls or ball_map); pin_header = 1- or 2-column pin header/socket strip (cols, rows, pitch; mount tht or smd); connector = any connector given as a pad_table from the datasheet's recommended PCB layout (signal pads, mounting pads MP, shield tabs SH, holes, slots); custom = anything else (odd shapes: polygon pads, slots, big pads with split paste / thermal vias) as a pad_table

pin_count.description: Signal pins, excluding exposed pad. chip: 2. bga: populated balls. pin_header: cols x rows. connector/custom: distinct numbered pins, not counting mounting pads (MP), shield tabs (SH) or holes.

pitch.description: Lead pitch e (gullwing/qfn/qfp); bga: ball pitch along a row (column to column); pin_header: pin pitch; connector: signal pin pitch (used to size through-hole pads and to check the table)

body_length.description: chip: overall length L (terminal end to end, = lead span). gullwing: body length D along the pin rows (Y). qfn: body size along X (D). bga/connector/custom/pin_header: body size along X (left-right in the top view).

body_width.description: chip: width W. gullwing: body width E1 (X, excluding leads). qfn: body size along Y (E). bga/connector/custom/pin_header: body size along Y.

lead_span.description: gullwing only: tip-to-tip lead span E (X). For chip it equals body_length; for qfn it equals body sizes.

terminal_length.description: chip: end-cap band length T. gullwing: foot length L (flat contact). qfn: terminal length L.

inner_span.description: chip/molded: inner gap S between the terminals when the drawing gives it directly (LED and molded drawings often do); used instead of body_length - 2*terminal_length

terminal_width.description: gullwing/qfn: lead width b. chip/molded: terminal width when narrower than the body (e.g. SMA/tantalum); omit to use body_width.

height_max.description: A max (seated height); used for 3D/descr only

pins_left_right.description: qfn: pins on each of the left and right sides (default pin_count/4)

pins_top_bottom.description: qfn: pins on each of the top and bottom sides (default pin_count/4)

paste_grid.description: N x N paste windows; default auto

density.description: IPC-7351B density level: A=most (max fillets), B=nominal, C=least

rows.description: bga: number of ball rows (lettered A, B, C ... from the top; JEDEC skips I O Q S X Z). pin_header: pins in each column (along Y).

cols.description: bga: number of ball columns (numbered 1, 2, 3 ... from the left). pin_header: 1 or 2 columns of pins.

pitch_y.description: bga: row-to-row pitch when it differs from pitch

ball_diameter.description: bga: ball diameter b (LGA: land/terminal diameter) as printed; the land is derived from the nominal size (IPC-7351B)

land_diameter.description: bga: the datasheet's recommended PCB land (pad) diameter, when given; it replaces the IPC-7351B land. pin_header: through-hole pad diameter.

ball_type.description: bga: collapsing (eutectic / SAC solder balls, most BGAs: land smaller than the ball), non_collapsing (high-melt or copper-core balls: land slightly larger), lga (flat lands, no balls)

land_style.description: bga: NSMD = non-solder-mask-defined (copper = land, mask opening larger; the usual choice), SMD = solder-mask-defined (copper larger, mask opening = land)

depopulated.description: bga: balls that are missing, by name ("E5") or as a rectangle of balls "E5:H8" (inclusive). Use this or ball_map.

ball_map.description: bga: the ball map, one string per row from row A down, one character per column from 1 (spaces ignored): any of O X # * 1 = ball, '-' or '.' or '0' = no ball.

row_letters.description: bga: jedec = skip I O Q S X Z (JEP95, AA after Y); all = every letter (some older parts)

mount.description: pin_header: through-hole (pin 1 at the footprint origin, KiCad style) or SMD

pin1_side.description: pin_header, single-row SMD: side of pin 1's pad (the pads alternate sides)

drill.description: pin_header: finished hole diameter (default from the pitch: 2.54 -> 1.0, 2.0 -> 0.8, 1.27 -> 0.65)

same_net.description: connector/custom: groups of pad numbers that are the same net and may overlap or touch (USB-C A1/B12 GND, A4/B9 VBUS)

courtyard_excess.description: Courtyard clearance around pads and body in mm, overriding the default (bga 1.0, connectors 0.5, custom 0.25 at density B)

pad_table.description: connector/custom: the land pattern copied from the datasheet's dimension drawing, in the drawing's own unit and frame (no arithmetic: positions as dimensioned from the drawing's origin). One entry per pad, or arrays for evenly spaced rows.

unit.description: unit of every number in the table

y_axis.description: up: +Y points to the top of the drawing (usual for drawings); down: +Y points down (KiCad)

view.description: the drawing's view: recommended land patterns are top views; bottom views (seen from the pins) are mirrored left-right

origin.description: what the drawing's 0,0 is: the package centre, pin 1, or another datum (give center_at)

center_at.description: the package centre in the table's coordinates, when the origin is not the centre (default: the middle of all pads)

footprint_origin.description: origin of the generated footprint: default pin1 for through-hole parts, center for SMD (KiCad conventions)

number.description: pad number as on the drawing / pin table (1, 2 ... or A1, B12 ...); mounting pads MP, shield tabs SH, holes ""

x.description: pad centre X, in the table's unit and frame

y.description: pad centre Y, in the table's unit and frame

shape.description: default roundrect for SMD, oval for through-hole, circle when d is given; use polygon points for odd shapes

type.description: smd (default), tht = plated through-hole (needs drill), npth = non-plated hole (locating peg)

drill.description: hole diameter; for a slot, its width

drill_h.description: slot: hole length along Y (the drill becomes an oval slot drill x drill_h); swap with drill for a slot along X

rotation.description: pad rotation in degrees, counter-clockwise as drawn

role.description: default: pin for numbered pads, mount for MP/MH, shield for SH/S1, npth for holes; mount/shield/npth are not counted as pins

polygon.description: odd-shaped pad: its outline corners in the table's frame (absolute, not relative to x/y)

paste.description: solder paste: full (default for SMD), none, or grid = split into windows (big thermal pads)

paste_coverage.description: grid paste: fraction of the copper covered (default 0.65)

paste_grid.description: grid paste: [columns, rows] of windows (default about 1.2 mm windows)

unit.description: unit of drill / diameter / pitch: mm (default), mil, in, or table = the pad table's unit

thermal_vias.description: vias inside a big pad (mm): drill, via diameter (default drill + 0.3), nx x ny grid, pitch (default spread over the pad), pitch_y (rows, default pitch); in mm unless unit says otherwise

paste_margin.description: solder paste expansion (negative = smaller than the copper)

label.description: the drawing's callout for this pad, for review

default_pad.description: values every pad and array takes unless it gives its own

dx.description: step to the next pad along X (the pitch, negative to go left)

number_step.description: numbering step (default 1; 2 for one row of a dual-row connector: 1, 3, 5 ...)

prefix.description: letters before the number (A for USB-C A1..A12)

arrays.description: evenly spaced rows of equal pads, as drawings dimension them (N x pitch)

body.description: the component body outline (top view), in the table's unit and frame

keepouts.description: keep-out areas from the drawing (no copper / no vias / no tracks under the part), rectangle or polygon

model_3d.description: Optional 3D model path to reference, e.g. ${KICAD8_3DMODEL_DIR}/Package_SO.3dshapes/SOIC-8_3.9x4.9mm_P1.27mm.wrl

source.description: Provenance for review: datasheet URL, page/figure, and the drawing's package code.

unresolved.description: Dimensions the extractor could not read with confidence (requires human review)

lead_type.description: Optional IPC lead family override (default comes from package_type): molded = inward L / molded body (tantalum, SMA/SMB, SOD-123F; IPC-7351B Table 3-13), melf = cylindrical end caps (MELF/MiniMELF), flat = outward flat leads (IPC-7352 flat lead)

polarized.description: Pin 1 is a polarity terminal (LED/diode cathode, tantalum +). Adds the KiCad-style silk bracket on the pin-1 side and a chamfered fab corner.

pin_positions.description: gullwing: explicit pad layout when the rows are uneven (SOT-23: 1 L -0.95, 2 L +0.95, 3 R 0). offset = mm along the row from the centre, + down.

number.description: pad number: letters, digits and _ . + - only (KLC uses 1, 2, 3 ...)

tab.description: gullwing: one wide tab lead on a side (SOT-223, DPAK). Same lead span as the pins.

number.description: pad number: letters, digits and _ . + - only (KLC uses 1, 2, 3 ...)

lead_span_y.description: qfp only: tip-to-tip span of the top/bottom rows when it differs from lead_span (rectangular QFP)

land.description: The manufacturer's recommended land pattern, when the datasheet gives one. It replaces the IPC-7351B pads for the signal pins (a tab or exposed pad keeps its own size). pad_center = distance from the part centre to each pad centre: half the centre-to-centre distance across the rows (a datasheet's C / 2).

pad_center_y.description: QFN/QFP top and bottom rows, when different from pad_center
